item.tib: snyan rgyud dbal 'bar stag slag can gyi bon skyongs yongs kyi skong bskul sham bu
item.coloph: bon skyongs sham bu 'di yang ma cig srid pa'i rgyal mo'i bya ra ma gsum la brgyud/ bya ra ma gsum gyis kho bo dbra btsun g.yung drung bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal bdag la dben gnas maN Dal ri khrod du/ shing sbrul zla ba'i tshes la snyan du brgyud pa'o/ de ltar gu ger ris su phab pa 'dis kyang las bzhi 'dod gsol gang brtsal 'bad med lhun gyis grub par gyur cig/
